record_schema.source_entity_id: boss, dungeon, raid, quest, creature, or other source entity
record_schema.loot_type: boss_drop | dungeon_drop | raid_drop | quest_reward | world_drop | rare_creature_drop | other

data_rules: Loot relationships are separate from item entities so one item can have multiple documented sources.
Never infer drop rates from Classic or similarly named encounters.
A loot relationship is only confirmed when the source supports the specific source-to-item relationship.
Keep unknown drop rates as null rather than estimating them.
